svg.text: 01a-street-dive: Dive at the Tower gap street floor
— filter: clearance of its best verified escape
height above the street (m) — danger on the left
rows 1-6: the filter's escapes; search rows: green = an escape was found; outer bound: red = proven unsafe.
n / α in a cell: the escape law's load-factor / angle-of-attack cap bound on over 15% of its frames
